name: 01_matching_coverage_balance
caption: The 243-configuration search used 40,000 complete rows for Aa_20yr and did not access health outcomes. Coverage, SMD, environmental distance, and exposure separation were all retained; the horizontal line is a descriptive balance reference.

name: 02_matching_method_pair_fit
caption: Full-sample paired R² is descriptive and not used as the matching selection objective. M3 is soil-specific K-means k=6 plus matching; M4 is direct nearest-neighbor matching within exact soil strata.

name: 03_primary_paired_slopes
caption: Points show full-sample P1 matched-pair slopes and 95% model-based confidence intervals. These intervals do not adjust for residual spatial dependence; the repeated 5km holdout results are reported separately.

name: 04_repeated_spatial_validation
caption: Each box summarizes ten seeded, whole-block 5km spatial test splits. M0–M2 use a common complete-case pixel sample across both Aa periods; M3–M4 use independently constructed train, validation and test pairs with train-fitted transformations.

name: 05_erosion_increment_delta_r2
caption: For each seed and outcome, the environment-only and environment-plus-log1p(Aa) OLS models use the same training pixels and score the same held-out pixels. This is predictive increment, not causal effect or independent data validation.

name: 06_environmental_heterogeneity
caption: Subgroup estimates use M4 full-sample pairs and prespecified soil, V5 K-means and environmental tertile definitions. Groups were fitted or binned descriptively; subgroup differences remain exploratory and multiple testing is adjusted by Benjamini–Hochberg in the table.

name: 07_environment_groups_map_and_high_response
caption: Left: a deterministic sample of valid cells colored by soil-specific V5 K-means group (Elevation and LST), shown as points on the projected grid. Right: for primary exposure Aa_20yr, the top three full-sample mean-response groups for each primary outcome. The Aa_2020 screen is available in the accompanying table. The top groups are outcome-ranked descriptive subsets, not independently validated hotspots; no continuous or causal spatial surface is inferred.

name: 08_health_response_curves
caption: Blue points use the fixed 10,000-row plotting sample; complete cases are used for each outcome. Orange dashed curves are natural-spline fits to that same plotting sample. Green curves are prior Oracle-selected full-sample apparent model partial-dependence curves for Aa_20yr at median environmental conditions, selected by apparent R² from 1,024 model trials across 13 families. Each green curve's selected model and complete-case n are in the figure data. The curves use different sample scopes; neither is an independent validation curve.

name: 09_pair_distance_and_exposure_diagnostics
caption: Each point is a full-sample M4 pair. Red points indicate a zero-to-positive exposure pair. Distance distributions are matching diagnostics; the full spatial-validation performance is in Figure 4.

name: 10_exposure_period_comparison
caption: Aa_20yr and Aa_2020 are compared with the same complete pixels, V5 variables, OLS design and spatial seeds for the cell-level analysis. Full-sample matched pairs are exposure-specific and are displayed in the accompanying table rather than treated as paired-period identical samples.
